title: LMAX Sequencer Architecture (Trading Hot Path)
description: State 009 runtime with the trading hot path rebuilt as a sequenced, journaled, single-threaded in-memory BLP wired with disruptor rings; external contracts unchanged.

nodes.label: TraderX App Runtime
nodes.description: State 009 runtime baseline with the LMAX hot-path replacement.

nodes.label: Observability Runtime
nodes.description: LGTM + OTel stack from state 007 carried forward with hot-path telemetry coverage.

nodes.label: NGINX Ingress
nodes.description: Routes UI, API, and order admin traffic (unchanged).

nodes.label: Angular Trade UI
nodes.description: Trade ticket, order ticket, blotters, and admin tab (unchanged).

nodes.label: Gateway (Trade Service)
nodes.description: Receptionist role: validates via in-memory replicas, maps ticker to securityId, fixed-point converts, SBE-encodes, submits sequenced input events.

nodes.label: Price Publisher
nodes.description: Market tick source (unchanged node); ticks enter the sequenced stream via the Gateway.

nodes.label: Input Disruptor + Sequencer
nodes.description: Pre-allocated ring; global sequence assignment; parallel journaler/replicator/un-marshaller; sequence barrier gating the BLP.

nodes.label: Event Journal
nodes.description: Durable, replicated, authoritative append-only log of sequenced input events (Chronicle Queue / Aeron Archive).

nodes.label: Business Logic Processor
nodes.description: Single thread, in-memory, event-sourced: order books, positions, caches; match + book + position + emit.

nodes.label: Replica BLP (warm standby)
nodes.description: Consumes the replicated input stream in lock-step with output suppressed; promoted on leader failure. Loopback/stub in demo profile.

nodes.label: Output Disruptor
nodes.description: Single-producer egress ring with parallel marshaller, NATS publisher, and read-model projector handlers.

nodes.label: NATS Broker
nodes.description: Realtime transport; subjects and payloads unchanged from 009.

nodes.label: Read-model Projector
nodes.description: Batched, checkpointed, rebuildable async writer of OrderBook/trade/position rows.

nodes.label: Shared Database (read-model)
nodes.description: Same schema as 009; demoted to an async read-model projected from output events.

nodes.label: Prometheus
nodes.description: Scrapes hot-path, order, and allocation metrics plus blackbox probes.

nodes.label: Blackbox Exporter
nodes.description: Probes order endpoints and inherited runtime endpoints.

nodes.label: Loki
nodes.description: Aggregates runtime logs (hot-path logging is async/off-thread).

nodes.label: Grafana
nodes.description: Dashboards for ring headroom, sequence lag, BLP/egress latency, projector lag, allocation rate, GC pauses.

edges.label: Claims slot, writes SBE event, publishes
